chapter_note: Strong cosmological core describing four weepings of the sons of the First Man — three at the original confrontation with Darkness, and a fourth eschatological weeping by the firmaments of the elements over souls bound to the Last Andrias. The cosmology is intact through ~i=35. The second half (i=36ff) drifts heavily into apostolic biography (suffering, crucifixion of apostles, prophets of truth) and concludes with hortatory pastoral material about meditation before God and the apostles. Editorial fatigue score (+1.83) confirms the structural shift. Heavy lacunae throughout the cosmological section but the teaching armature is recoverable.
